Concentrated triage batch: `finding` → `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, Task, M — inherits maintainer ruling A (objectstack#10235) via #5729's landed contract spelling: converge the two remaining sort-axis consumers (`ListView.tsx:2409` sort picker, RelatedList) onto `isPlatformSortableField`, deleting their `UNMATERIALIZED_FIELD_TYPES` re-derivations. Preserve the picker's deliberate keep-current-sort behaviour (the body's tail documents it — read before editing); pin each surface.

assignee.

### Pre-dispatch gate

- **(a) Whole thread read** — one record, triage's grading of 2026-08-25T04:13Z. No prior claim.
- **(b) Shadow check, in-flight and batch.** In flight: #6038, #6416 (`plugin-report` +
  `apps/console` + CLI), #6419 (`plugin-view`), #6004 (`plugin-grid`). ⚠️ **#6004 holds
  `ObjectGrid.tsx`** — which is this card's *precedent* consumer, to be **read, never edited**.
  ⛔ Do not touch `packages/plugin-grid/**`; if your convergence seems to need a change there,
  stop and report instead.
- **(c) Call-site census on `origin/main` `fdefd4b01`** — and it did not come out as the card
  describes:

**The landed contract** (inherits maintainer ruling A, objectstack#10235, via #5729):
```
packages/core/src/utils/column-sortability.ts:201  export function isPlatformSortableField(…)
packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:2506       // `isPlatformSortableField` is the contract: an entry must EXIST and say …
```

**The re-derivation I can see:**
```
packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2438  // Second rule — `UNMATERIALIZED_FIELD_TYPES` …
packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2464  if (!relational && !UNMATERIALIZED_FIELD_TYPES.has(field.type)) {
```

⚠️ **Two discrepancies with the card, both yours to resolve before writing:**

1. The card names the picker at `ListView.tsx:2409`; today the re-derivation reads at **`:2464`**.
   Line drift — ⛔ do not trust either number, re-derive.
2. ⭐ **My grep for `UNMATERIALIZED_FIELD_TYPES` surfaced ListView but NOT RelatedList.** The card
   names RelatedList as the second consumer. So either it re-derives sortability by a *different*
   spelling, or the card's claim needs re-checking. **Census the shape — "re-derives sortability
   from field type" — not the symbol `UNMATERIALIZED_FIELD_TYPES`.** A second consumer that
   matches no symbol you already know is exactly the miss this lane keeps making.

   If RelatedList turns out not to re-derive at all, that is a **finding to report** and the card
   shrinks to one surface. Say so rather than converging something that was already converged.

### Preserve the deliberate behaviour

Triage: *"Preserve the picker's deliberate keep-current-sort behaviour (the body's tail documents
it — **read before editing**)."* ⛔ That is not incidental: converging the predicate must not
change what the picker does with a sort already applied.

### Pin each surface

Triage asked for a pin **per surface**, not one covering pin. Whatever you pin, prove it fails: put
back the `UNMATERIALIZED_FIELD_TYPES` re-derivation, observe red, quote both readings, restore by
**hash** rather than exit code, and state the predicted direction before each run.

⚠️ Note the shape of the vacuity risk here: `isPlatformSortableField` and the deleted re-derivation
**agree on most inputs** — that is why the drift went unnoticed. A pin over inputs where the two
agree proves nothing. Find the inputs where they **disagree** (the card's body documents the
family the re-derivation gets backwards) and pin those.

Deliver a **draft** PR with `Fixes #6108`. ⛔ Do not mark ready, ⛔ do not self-merge, ⛔ do not
enable auto-merge — the PM lands it.

## PM review — **ACCEPT**

PR #6454, head `27f9d10f6`. `domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat, PM session
`session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`. Verified on a pinned ref (`refs/pmtmp/6108`).

### ⭐ Both dispatch discrepancies resolved — and the important one went against my reading

I flagged at claim: *"my grep for `UNMATERIALIZED_FIELD_TYPES` surfaced ListView but NOT
RelatedList — so either RelatedList re-derives under a different spelling, or the card's claim is
stale."*

**The card was right. My grep was too literal.** Verified on `origin/main`:

```
packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:1146  return isExpandableFieldType(fieldDef) || isUnmaterializedFieldType(fieldDef)
packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:1391  if (windowed && (isExpandableFieldType(fieldDef) || isUnmaterializedFieldType(fieldDef))) {
```

`UNMATERIALIZED_FIELD_TYPES` appears **zero** times in `plugin-detail` — RelatedList re-derives
through **`isUnmaterializedFieldType(fieldDef)`**, the same judgement under a different name, at
exactly the two sites the card named. ⭐ **Censusing the shape rather than the symbol is what found
it**, which was the instruction, and it means this card covers **three** surfaces rather than one.

Line drift also confirmed: the picker reads at `:2464`, not the card's `:2409`. Re-derived, not
trusted.

### ⭐⭐ Why the pins are not vacuous — this is the part that makes the PR

The dispatch warned that the two predicates **agree on most inputs**, which is precisely why the
drift survived two cards, and that a pin over an agreement input proves nothing. The dev built
every load-bearing cell on an input where they **disagree**, one per family:

| family | contract (`isPlatformSortableField`) | the deleted type read |
|---|---|---|
| **absence** — unprovisioned audit column; dotted path `account.name` | withholds | finds no field def → **offers** |
| **a refusal carrying no `reason:'virtual-type'`** on a text field | withholds | **offers** |
| ⭐ **the platform moving** — a formula the projection answers `sortable: true` for | **offers** | withholds on the type alone, forever |

⭐ **That last cell runs the opposite direction from all the others, which is what makes an
accidentally-passing pin impossible.** A pin whose cells all fail the same way can be satisfied by
one broken axis; a pin with a reversed cell cannot. That is the asymmetry discipline applied to a
convergence rather than to a deletion, and I had not asked for it in that form.

And the fixtures are generated by the platform's **own `resolveObjectSortability`** from
`@objectstack/spec/api` — the resolver the REST layer serves the projection from — rather than a
copied table, with the base asserted before anything is measured against it.

### The ablations, predicted then measured

- **Leg A** (ListView reverted): predicted red on drift cells, green on the floor → `7 failed |
  2 passed`, and ⭐ **the 2 still green are exactly the predicted ones** — the
  served-no-projection floor and the relational carve-out.
- **Leg B** (RelatedList reverted): predicted 8 of 13 red → `8 failed | 5 passed`, observed exactly.

Mutation proven on disk by grepping **injected and deleted text at the anchor**, with the replacer
asserting `count == 1` and exiting 93 on an anchor miss — so a no-op edit could not be read as a
run. Restore proven by **blob hash** against HEAD, empty hash treated as failure, absolute paths
under a trap.

### Three behaviours deliberately preserved, each separately pinned

The relational carve-out stays **out of the signal** (the projection answers `sortable: true` for a
lookup; the UI withholds for its own reason); the picker's **keep-current-sort** exception survives
and now covers platform-refused fields rather than only formulas — that was the "preserve the
deliberate behaviour" instruction, and it was widened correctly rather than preserved narrowly; and
the no-signal-served branch keeps the type read as a **compatibility floor**.

### Fence respected

⛔ `plugin-grid/**` untouched — verified, zero files in the diff. `ObjectGrid` was read as the
precedent consumer and needed no change, exactly as fenced.

### Out of scope, filed not fixed

**#6455** — the in-use exception this card was told to preserve **re-emits the refused entry**
through `onSortChange → persistViewPatch({sort})`, and `filterPlatformSortableSort` (core's
emit-side half of the same ruling) has exactly **one** consumer. ⭐ Correctly a card and not a
rider: it needs the render seam split from the persist seam. **#6456** — the compatibility floor is
now duplicated across three files / four call sites with its coordinated deletion scheduled only in
source comments.

⚠️ #6455 carries no labels; #6456 carries `finding` + `domain:ui`. Both land in the triage sweep;
grading is that seat's, not mine.

### Landing

⛔ Not enqueued — 24 green, **5 still running**, 0 failures, `behind` (⛔ not syncing).
